Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
[Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301) tells me you are going to America.

Should you go to Philadelphia, and if so would it be very troublesome to take charge of a roll of paper containing an illumination that cannot be trusted by post?[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Macmillan agreed to take the parcel to CMY’s correspondent [Miss Lewis](../persons.html#873), of 710 Pine St., Philadelphia.
